title: Keep billing authority in product rules, not the model
narrative: A customer was charged twice. Only the billing team may own the ticket. The model may suggest a team, but product policy allows only when the route signal is billing — and a high quality score alone must not override missing completion evidence. See also `fangore_decision_surface_reject`.
implementation:
Provider-neutral judge types (`Choice`/`Score`/`Noul` questions and signals) plus `JudgementPolicy` / `decide()` apply configured thresholds. Judge scores are supplementary: policy owns ALLOW/DENY. Thresholds live in policy config per signal id. System One maps vendor wire into these types via `SystemOneJudgeProvider`.

Covers: POL-02, JDG-01, JDG-02, JDG-04, VER-02.
validation: Kind `route_refund` → `_run_route_refund`. Soft expects: ALLOW for billing, DENY for technical. Unit: `tests/test_judgement_policy.py`, `tests/test_judge.py`.
